from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DebtEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted long-term borrowing information from a single company's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the financial statements belong to")
    long_term_debt_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount classified as long-term borrowings; 0.0 if none found")
    debt_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    liability_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of liability (e.g., 'mortgage', 'notes', 'lease', 'none')")
    classification_context: str | None = Field(description="Context explaining why it is long-term or why total debt is current")
    evidence_quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim text supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    debt_entries: list[DebtEntry]
